```sql
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT yearID, SUM(HR) AS total_hr
  FROM Batting
  WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2014 AND 2024
  GROUP BY yearID
)
SELECT yearID, total_hr, total_hr - LAG(total_hr) OVER (ORDER BY yearID) AS change_from_prev_year
FROM yearly
WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
ORDER BY yearID
```

Wait — filtering after the window function in the same query would drop 2014 before LAG is computed only if applied in the same SELECT's WHERE; here the WHERE runs before the window function. Corrected version:

```sql
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT yearID, SUM(HR) AS total_hr
  FROM Batting
  WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2014 AND 2024
  GROUP BY yearID
),
diffed AS (
  SELECT yearID, total_hr, total_hr - LAG(total_hr) OVER (ORDER BY yearID) AS change_from_prev_year
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT yearID, total_hr, change_from_prev_year
FROM diffed
WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
ORDER BY yearID
```
